title: Your pictures
comment: Your photos are fields too: open one, its painting as it is; its luminance,
a field from 0 to 1, painted in ember; its own five colours as a palette;
the painting itself in pixels; a kaleidoscope of the field in its own
colours. photo.jpg is yours (a frame of a phone clip here; not in the repo):

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: your pictures
stage: let hk1 = text("07  ·  your pictures", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: open: the photo, as it is
sections.label: open
sections.say: Open a photo. Its painting, as it is.

sections.name: its luminance, a field, painted in ember
sections.label: luma
sections.say: Its luminance is a field, zero to one. Paint it in ember.

sections.name: its own five colours as a palette
sections.label: its colours
sections.say: Its own five colours, as a palette.

sections.name: a kaleidoscope of the field, in its own colours
sections.label: kaleidoscope
sections.say: A field like any other: a kaleidoscope, in its own colours.

sections.name: the end
sections.say: Next week: patterns. Ten thousand dots, each one drawn by chance.
stage: let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.68, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 50.8)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.68) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 50.8)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  07  ·  your pictures", x: 0.5, y: 0.82, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 51.3)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.93, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 51.8)
let e3 = text("next  ·  08  ·  patterns", x: 0.5, y: 1.06, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l7.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 52.8)
let endf = max(k7_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))

overlays.paint: place(paint(photo.luma, palette: "ember", range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(photo.luma, palette: pal, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
place(paint(kaleidoscope(photo.luma, 8), palette: pal, range: [0, 1]), x: 0.5, y: 0.95, width: 0.36, height: 0.64)
